users.title: Users
users.selfRoles: These are your own roles. You can't give yourself more than you hold, and the last administrator stays.
users.selfTeams: Nobody changes their own teams: another administrator does.

remove.title: Remove {{email}}?
remove.description: Their membership here ends: they are signed out of this workspace and lose its roles. Their account and other workspaces stay. You can restore their access later.

impersonate.title: Act as {{email}}?
impersonate.description: Your session becomes theirs for a limited time, and everything you do is recorded as you acting as them. Stop from the banner to get your own session back.

grants.hint: Each role may end at a date and time (temporary access); leave it empty for no end.
grants.untilPast: Pick a time in the future.

invitations.inviteDescription: They get an email with a link. Their membership, with these roles and teams, starts when they accept.

fields.name: Name (optional)
fields.nameHint: Only for a new account; its owner can change it.

invitations.resendDescription: The current link stops working and a new one is emailed, with the same roles and teams. End dates of roles aren't kept.
invitations.resent: A new link was sent to {{email}}.

roles.title: Roles
roles.builtIn: This role is built in: it can't be changed or deleted.
roles.unknown: These permissions are no longer offered and will be dropped when you save:
roles.deleteDescription_one: {{count}} person has it: they lose its permissions.
roles.deleteDescription_other: {{count}} people have it: they lose its permissions.

editor.hint: Tick what this role may do. A rule with conditions covers only the records that meet all of them; add another rule to cover more.
editor.notHeld: You don't hold this permission, so you can't grant it.
editor.everyRecord: Applies to every record. Tick conditions to narrow it:
editor.allOf: Applies only to records that meet all of:

teams.title: Teams
teams.dialogDescription: Moving a team moves every team under it. Members of a team see what its teams below own ("in my teams").
teams.deleteDescription: Only an empty team can be deleted: no members and no teams under it.
teams.needsManageUsers: Adding and removing members changes their membership: it needs the permission to manage users.
teams.noMembers: Nobody is in this team directly.
teams.removeDescription: They lose what this team gives them.
